name: Lake Jackson
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Lake Jackson, TX 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Lake Jackson, TX: the city's Light Up Lake Jackson, with a holiday StoryWalk at MacLean Park through December 31, 2026.
lede: Lake Jackson spreads its Christmas across a month of free city events called Light Up Lake Jackson, from a park StoryWalk to Santa mailboxes.
celebrates: The City of Lake Jackson holds Holidays in Lake Jackson each year, starting the week before Thanksgiving with the Festival of Lights. In 2026 the city is also running the seventh annual Light Up Lake Jackson, which it describes as 13 free events shared online through January. Walk the Lights is the Holiday StoryWalk at MacLean Park in December. Mail the Lights puts Santa mailboxes at City Hall and the Rec Center. Decorate the Lights is a house decorating contest, and Recycle the Lights collects old string lights at city locations through January 5, 2027.
lastyear: In 2025, the City of Lake Jackson held its Santa in the Lights tour on Saturday, December 20, from 9 am to 4 pm, with firefighters taking Santa to neighborhoods and a GPS map for families to follow him. A Visit Brazosport post also lists the Parade of Lights at 7 pm on Saturday, November 22, 2025, during the Festival of Lights. We did not find a local news recap of last year's crowds.
facts: Lake Jackson's Light Up Lake Jackson is in its seventh year, and the city describes it as 13 free events shared on its website and social pages. Keep Lake Jackson Beautiful says it can collect more than 400 pounds of old string lights every holiday season through Recycle the Lights, and the group has earned the Governor's Achievement Award from Keep Texas Beautiful 14 times, more than any other city in the state, according to the city.
trains: We did not find a Christmas train in Lake Jackson this year. The nearest rail events we could confirm are The Polar Express at the Galveston Railroad Museum and the kiddie train at Moody Gardens' Holiday in the Gardens, both on our Galveston page. Families can also plan a day out to the Galveston Railroad Museum or the Rosenberg Railroad Museum.
train_links: Home of The Polar Express train ride in Galveston, already listed on our Galveston page.
A railroad museum in Rosenberg, a drive from the Houston area.
traditions: The city's Holidays in Lake Jackson begin the week before Thanksgiving with the Festival of Lights.
A holiday StoryWalk at MacLean Park, December 1 to 31.
Santa mailboxes at City Hall and the Rec Center; mail letters by December 16 for a reply.
A house decorating contest, with judging December 5 to 19 and winners announced December 20.
Old string lights can be dropped off at nine city locations through January 5, 2027.
kidfact: Lake Jackson has its own Christmas storybook, Lake Jackson's Holiday Secret, about why Santa comes to town.
faq: What is Light Up Lake Jackson?
The city's seventh annual holiday program, with 13 free events shared on its website and social pages from late November into January.
MacLean Park, 93 Lake Rd, Lake Jackson, TX 77566, from December 1 to 31, 2026.
How can my child write to Santa?
Use the Santa mailboxes at City Hall or the Rec Center. Mail letters by December 16 and print your child's name and address if you want a reply.
Can we enter our house in a contest?
Yes. Decorate the Lights lets residents register their homes until December 11, with judging from December 5 to 19.
